name: SetStage without stage check
description: Opt-in: flags a SetStage call on the script's own quest with no earlier GetStageDone/GetStage check in the same function. Only relevant for quests with "Allow Repeated Stages" enabled. Fragment scripts are skipped.
definition: Flags, as an `[info]`, a `SetStage(...)` or `Self.SetStage(...)` call in a script extending `Quest` (directly or through a resolvable parent) when no `GetStageDone`, `GetStage`, `GetCurrentStageID` or `IsStageDone` call comes before it in the same function or event. This only matters for quests with "Allow Repeated Stages" ticked in the CreationKit: by default `SetStage` on an already-set stage is a no-op, but with that flag it re-runs the stage's fragment, duplicating its side effects; guarding it with `If !GetStageDone(N)` avoids that. The linter cannot see quest flags, so the rule is off by default and not enabled by any preset (including `strict`); turn it on in `rules:` for projects whose quests use repeated stages. Only same-function checks are tracked, so a guard in a calling function is not seen; intentional re-entry can be silenced with a disable comment. `SetStage` on another quest is not checked. CreationKit fragment scripts (a `;BEGIN FRAGMENT` marker or a `Fragment_<digits>` function) are skipped entirely, since their code runs under stage, dialogue or scene conditions set elsewhere.
